name: Wuu
source:
Wuu (called Lis in Rance III) is a young member of the incredibly rare Round One species known as Lis that became a human through the power of love. He is the fiance of [url=/c36799]Rola Indus[/url]. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Wuu]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
